Generate image(s) via the gateway.

Returns images immediately for sync providers (Google, OpenAI) or
an operation_id for async providers (Fal, Replicate).

Request body:
    model (str): Image model name
    prompt (str): Generation prompt
    number_of_images (int, optional): Number of images to generate (default: 1)
    aspect_ratio (str, optional): e.g. "1:1", "16:9"
    image_size (str, optional): e.g. "1024x1024"
    quality (str, optional): e.g. "standard", "hd"
    input_images (list[str

Poll async image generation status (Fal/Replicate providers only).

Query params:
    model (str): Image model name used for generation
